en.headline: Man arrested after falling while fleeing Yau Ma Tei flat burglary
en.dek: Police say a 44-year-old Pakistani man was caught after climbing from a window of a Shanghai Street tenement unit and falling; he was taken to hospital with a waist injury.
body: Police arrested a man on suspicion of burglary in Yau Ma Tei on Sunday afternoon after he fell while attempting to flee a tenement flat.

Officers were called to Shanghai Street at about 1.45pm after a resident reported that the door of a neighbouring vacant unit appeared to have been forced open and noises were heard inside. While investigating, they saw a non-ethnic Chinese man climbing out of a window of the unit.

The man, later identified as a 44-year-old Pakistani holding a Hong Kong identity card, fell and sustained a waist injury. He was arrested at the scene and taken by ambulance to Kwong Wah Hospital. A slipper was found on a canopy below and a broken branch was noted at the scene.
The case is being handled by the Yau Tsim District Crime Investigation Team 6. Police said losses at the unit were still being assessed.

zh.headline: 油麻地唐樓疑爆竊 巴裔男爬窗逃走墮地受傷被捕
zh.dek: 警方下午約1時45分接報上海街唐樓單位大門疑被撬開，發現44歲巴基斯坦裔男子爬窗逃去時墮下腰傷，當場拘捕。
body: 油麻地周日下午發生一宗懷疑爆竊案，一名男子逃走時墮地受傷被捕。
警方下午約1時45分接獲上海街122號唐樓住戶報案，指毗鄰一個空置單位大門疑被撬開，單位內有聲響。警員到場調查期間，發現一名非華裔男子疑從該單位窗口爬出逃走。
該名44歲巴基斯坦裔男子持有香港身份證，逃走時失足墮下腰部受傷，當場被拘捕，其後由救護車送往廣華醫院治理。現場帆布簷篷遺下一隻拖鞋，並有樹枝折斷。
案件交由油尖警區刑事調查隊第六隊跟進，遇竊單位財物損失仍在點算中。
